answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a cost that cannot be cloned: each agent identity must stake a refundable bond that is slashed the moment one persona is proven to share operators with another. Collusion is detected by replaying signed resource receipts, so a zephyr of free throwaway keys buys nothing. To open positions an attacker must lock real capital per persona, spread across a lagoon of wallets, and losing the kernel of trust in any single one burns the whole cluster. That turns every fake million identities into a million locked deposits.
